builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from Flux empowered Overload within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Flux empowered Overload within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.

Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record Flux empowered Overload tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Verify raw helper/statFormula mappings and conditional multipliers before treating result as established.

Rune reasoning: Ryze — Flux empowered Overload: Use adaptive stats for the actual damage helper and a finisher matching the starting enemy/owner HP. The keystone proc is measured separately; damage type alone does not justify attack speed, crit, or an ultimate modifier. Ability basis: Q5 is155+0.55AP+0.02 bonusMana; R3 Flux multiplies1.9. Passive AP-to-mana and Seraph mana-to-AP justify mana/AP candidate; MR penetration affects magic. Deathcap multiplies AP; earned Seraph supplies mana and observed Awe AP. Zhonya/Banshee each add105AP. Void Arcane Comet: Comet is separate damage and can miss; target movement and range affect the comparison. Manaflow Band: Earned maximum mana/resource utility; only actual mana conversions can turn it into offensive stats. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Haste: Cooldown utility; no extra casts inside a one-cast benchmark. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time. Manaflow: log ten actually earned procs if using its 250 bonus mana; never invent full stacks or mana-to-AP conversion.

Rune comparison: Compare a real prepared Conqueror page versus the selected page without changing target defenses, HP, earned item stacks, rank or time. Additional rune preparation must be its own recorded trial. Compare First Strike or a damage keystone only in a separately reported total-hit result; proc damage is outside the named native packet.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

No invented passive coefficient/infinite feedback; no Manaflow on ceilingAP assumed; E damage excluded; unlimited Storm time lacks finite global max. Raw statFormula=2/Stat identifiers remain source evidence until runtime mapping confirmed; no unspecified stats/stacks granted.
tradeoffs: Six final items explicitly replace late-game boots; slower access/escape, extreme cost and setup dependence. Raw-number candidate sacrifices practical positioning and does not prove a global maximum.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.
coverageNotes: Rune review (2026-10-19): Optimize the named native single-hit benchmark; report rune proc output separately. No numerical/global optimum is certified; unsupported rune interactions and stat conversions require client tests. Separate all keystone, Scorch, Shield Bash, Font, and item proc output from the selected native metric. These are reasoned choices and comparison candidates; not a complete numerical rune solver or in-game verification.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: {{Spell_RyzeW_Name}} and {{Spell_RyzeE_Name}} refresh this Ability's Cooldown and charge a rune for [4] seconds (max [2] runes).

Active: Ryze unleashes a blast, dealing [75 / 95 / 115 / 135 / 155 + (0.55) × AP + 0.02 × AbilityResource(default, statFormula=2)] magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the target has Flux on it, it is consumed, causing this Ability to deal @Spell.RyzeR:OverloadDamageBonus@% increased damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux.

Ryze also discharges all runes, granting Ryze [28 / 32 / 36 / 40 / 44]% Move Speed for [2] seconds if [2] runes were charged.

builds.name: Rune Prison: AP and bonus-mana burst

builds.goal: Investigate high one Rune Prison impact output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: W deals 60/90/120/150/180 + 0.6 AP + 3% bonus maximum mana magic. Arcane Mastery increases maximum mana with AP, while Seraph supplies another conversion that partial models do not fully certify. Read actual final AP and maximum mana; bonus mana is final maximum minus champion base mana, not current available mana.
